issue: API returns 500 on special characters in query params

observations.content: Reused existing fix on branch fix/special-chars-query-params rather than reimplementing. The sanitizeQuery() function in src/sanitize/query.ts already correctly handles all four attack vectors: null-byte injection (stripped), path traversal (rejected with 400), Unicode/emoji (NFC-normalised), and SQL injection (intentionally passed through for DAL to handle with parameterised queries).

This repo has no git remote configured — PRs cannot be pushed. The test runner uses npx tsx directly (no jest/vitest). Test infrastructure was added as part of this fix since master only had echo stubs.

All 15 tests pass. The root cause of the 500 was a TypeError in SearchController.search calling .normalize() on undefined/mangled input. The sanitiser now guarantees NFC-normalised strings before they reach controllers.
